## Deterministic recovery workflow v4.7

Inactive evaluation copy.

All v4.6 claim, evidence-window, semantic, source-family, primary-lineage, temporal, absolute-claim, blocking-risk, dynamic-industry, and no-publication controls remain active.

When the ranking model returns no verified candidate, the validator reviews qualified primary and credible-independent bundles. It may create up to three conservative fallback candidates only when both source records share at least three substantive terms and at least sixty percent of the derived topic terms appear in both records.

Fallback candidates use exact bundle URLs, bounded editorial language, conservative scoring, and the same final verification gate as model candidates. A bundle that cannot produce a concrete topic remains excluded. Editorial Planner v1.6.2 accepts this workflow.

Separate copy; schedule disabled and disconnected. All model stages use LiteLLM home-chat with separate extraction, privacy, evidence-ranking and editorial calls. All file inputs/outputs use the isolated acceptance directory. Bind dedicated IAS credentials; never activate without explicit approval. No drafting, image generation, messaging or publishing.

## Topic evidence extraction v4.5

Semantic tokenization splits punctuation and hyphens before stemming. Both source records must still support at least half of the substantive candidate topic.

Evidence repair locates the first candidate-aligned term and copies a contiguous five-to-eighteen-word window from the supplied title or description. The validator never adds a source URL outside the selected evidence bundle.

Threat, product, time-sensitive, absolute, promotional, ambiguous, and unsupported claims remain blocked.

Assign the existing Brave Header Auth credential to this Web Search node after import. v4.0 contains four Brave search nodes in total. This node runs paired NIST and CISA foundation searches for each meeting theme.
